workflow_contract: POST JSON webhook; JSON response; all workflows inactive after import.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 00 - Supervisor
agents.description: Routes named tasks to agent webhook paths. Never executes privileged work.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 02 - Security Auditor
agents.description: Read-only path hygiene scan. Not a source secret scan.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 04 - Database & Backup Reviewer
agents.description: Checks operator-supplied backup and restore evidence.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 05 - MikroTik Integration Test Gate
agents.description: Validates isolated test prerequisites; never runs RouterOS commands.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 06 - Backend Health Monitor
agents.description: GET /api/health only; does not test router/database.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 07 - Network Diagnosis Advisor
agents.description: Rule-based recommendations only; no RouterOS commands.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 08 - Payment Intake Guard
agents.description: Validates shape only; never confirms payment or activates account.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 09 - Financial Reconciliation
agents.description: Compares provided records; never writes the ledger.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 10 - Human Approval Gate
agents.description: Captures approval request; does not execute action.

agents.name: SmartNet Agent 11 - QA Safe Smoke Test
agents.description: Safe GET health probe only; skips all mutating tests.
